source: the live CSSOM on allbirds.com (theme.css is same-origin, readable); one theme, resolved at 1440 x 900

context: @supports (((-webkit-hyphens:none)) and (not (margin-trim:inline))) or ((-moz-orient:inline) and (not (color:rgb(from red r g b))))

tailwind.selector: .prose-headings\:font-medium :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))
.prose-headings\:font-normal :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))
